wholePhysicalScope: The 1912 Goad atlas plate 14 traces the whole building envelope and two open service courts. The two surviving Cypress-facing annex corners and the Peel wall axis fix the plan registration. The modern tower is a distinct building.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve both wings, the old corner dome, raised mansard pavilions, and two open service courts. Closer levels refine dormers, sash and the old Peel entrance.
limitations: The surviving annex corners locate the historic atlas plan. The original hotel and open service courts are traced at approximately 1:1200. Fine setbacks, roof sections, window bays and the largely undocumented courtyard elevations are interpreted.
The archival photograph is monochrome. The limestone, dark slate and metal finishes use approximate colors. Interior rooms and neighboring buildings are outside the model.
The dated placement represents circa 1912. Ground elevations use the unchanged original modern Terrarium field. Historic thresholds are approximate.
